proposed_widenings.name: ongoing_operations_on_activated_ability
proposed_widenings.justification: ActivatedAbilityMechanics (the magic-item activation family) has phases but no operations field. The Deck of Illusions requires ongoing operations identical in shape to OngoingEffectMechanics.operations — specifically an on_creature_studies trigger → ability_check_gate for disbelief, and an on_caster_spends_action trigger → reposition_attachment for mid-duration movement. These exact operations encode cleanly in the spell-only ongoing_effect family (as shown by silent_image.dhall), but that family is not available to magic items. No honest encoding exists without either (a) adding an operations field to ActivatedAbilityMechanics, or (b) introducing a new magic-item mechanics family that combines activation cost/resource/reset with ongoing operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that takes a Study action to visually inspect the illusory creature identifies it as an illusion with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. ... you can take a Magic action to move it anywhere within 30 feet of its card.

proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.card_moved
proposed_widenings.justification: The illusion ends when its card is physically moved (picked up, relocated on the ground). This is distinct from all existing DurationEndTrigger variants: it is not target_makes_attack_roll, target_deals_damage, target_casts_spell, target_dons_armor, target_damaged_by_caster_or_ally, target_takes_damage, or caster_recasts_spell. It is an object-interaction trigger on the attachment anchor (the card on the ground) — no current variant covers this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The illusion lasts until its card is moved or the illusion is dispelled (using a Dispel Magic spell or a similar effect).

notes: The item's draw-a-card-create-illusion core encodes straightforwardly as a magic item activation with a random_table phase (1d100 → 32 creature outcomes + card-drawer-self entry) followed by direct phases applying create_illusion atoms. The charge pool (up to 34 cards, single-use each) maps to charge_pool with resetCadence=never and destruction=permanent_on_empty. The create_illusion atom and reposition_attachment atom both exist. The disbelief check (on_creature_studies → ability_check_gate) and repositioning (on_caster_spends_action → reposition_attachment) both exist as ongoing operation patterns in the spell surface (see silent_image.dhall). The blocking gap is purely structural: ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no operations field, so those two ongoing triggers cannot be expressed in any existing magic-item mechanics family. A secondary gap is the 'card moved' early-end trigger. The '97-00 = card drawer' entry (self-illusion) is a minor authoring concern — create_illusion with caller-owned creature identity — not a surface gap.
